name: scheme-tools
description: Local dev tools for the scheme/ subsite (gate = canon + canonrows + notes + terms + inline + labels + figures + smoke + reduced + palette + opacity + duration + chipfit + geometry closed rules). Not shipped to GitHub Pages. Needs a server at http://localhost:8080.

scripts.gate: node check-canon.mjs && node check-canonrows.mjs && node check-notes.mjs && node check-terms.mjs && node check-inline.mjs && node check-labels.mjs && node check-figures.mjs && node smoke-all.mjs && node check-reduced.mjs && node check-palette.mjs && node check-opacity.mjs && node check-duration.mjs && node check-chipfit.mjs && node check-geometry.mjs --rules=diagonal,through,offedge
scripts.oracle:diff: test -f baselines/anim/_complete && test -f baselines/dom/_complete || { echo 'ORACLE INCOMPLETE: a run died partway, these dumps are not a full catalogue'; exit 1; }; diff -rq -x _complete baselines/anim-base baselines/anim && diff -rq -x _complete baselines/dom-base baselines/dom && echo 'ORACLE CLEAN: motion and structure identical to the baseline'
